fact: CAFI Managing Director Chaba Mokuku said a Business Facilitation Single Window at the One Stop Business Facilitation Centre (OBFC), designed to simplify business registration and licensing, has been deployed and is to be launched by the end of 2025 or early 2026.

Revenue Services Lesotho says businesses can contact the One Stop Business Facilitation Centre at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Small Business for help registering with RSL, and that companies register first with the relevant ministries and then obtain a TIN from RSL.
